_note: v0.31.0 (plan v0.31.0-sortable-masked M6) SSR contract masked-value@1 (ADR 0012): td_masked_value() ALWAYS prints the element `<td-masked-value data-td-ssr="masked-value@1" class="td-masked">` + the masked text + the toggle (hidden while the element is undefined) + the live region, exactly as <td-masked-value> renders them; hydrated IN PLACE.
